title: Shared channels and organization-owned bots
description:
Phase 5. Blocked entirely by 7b4616; do not start any of it before the door closes.

Bots become organization-owned, channels carry participants instead of an owner, and the computer serves the whole organization. Specification 14f692 comes first and gates the other three.

**Warning:** 6c1a9b, 0814e6, and ddf609 all edit models.py and messaging/store.py. Independent in logic, colliding in files. One agent, or strictly sequenced merges.
